evals.prompt: Run the import-source skill on notes/billing-questionnaire.md inside the repo at <workspace>/repo. The human has already answered the destination question: use docs/sources/. Write the imported file under <workspace>/repo/docs/sources/ and copy it, plus a report.md holding your final report, to <outputs>/.
evals.expected_output: One markdown file under docs/sources/ with the Source, Retrieved, and Formatting convention header, every question as a ### heading, every answer as a > **Answer:** blockquote keeping the Priya: prefix, and the ninety-day question marked > **Unanswered in source.**, plus a report naming that one anomaly.
expectations: Imported file starts with a # title followed by **Source:**, **Retrieved:**, and **Formatting convention:** lines and a --- rule
Every one of the four questions appears as a ### heading with its wording unchanged
Every one of the three answers appears as a > **Answer:** blockquote keeping the Priya: prefix and its wording unchanged
The ninety-day question is followed by > **Unanswered in source.**
Both framing paragraphs appear as plain prose with their wording unchanged
The report names the file written, the destination docs/sources/, and exactly one anomaly, the unanswered ninety-day question
